sourceName: Wikimedia Commons imageinfo (hand-selected journey stage monuments)
notes: Stage monuments for the Treble spin-off (docs/JOURNEY.md §4b): three trophy perspectives, not stadium exteriors.
16 May — squad celebration with the Premier League trophy at Old Trafford (Seán Murray, cropped).
22 May — Keane lifts the FA Cup at Wembley (Michael Cairns). Cache uses the full presentation file for resolution; objectPosition matches the Commons cropped framing on Keane.
After May — open-top bus parade with all three trophies (Seán Murray). No licensed Camp Nou European Cup lift exists on Commons; the parade is the haul.
climaxAtmosphere remains available as the single immersive alternative (Camp Nou winners board).
Stadium exterior WebPs (old-trafford/wembley/camp-nou) are retained on disk from the earlier place trial but are no longer the stage records.
